english.title: Obstruct a person serving a control order notice - Prevention of Terrorism 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed

(A)_[a police constable]_
(B)_[an authorised person]_

whilst delivering a notice under section 7(8) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 relating to

(C)_[a control order]_
(D)_[the renewal or modification of a control order]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(3) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Fifty one weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Note:
Summary conviction maximum six months imprisonment until section 281(5) Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force).

Time limit on Prosecutions
None
